sources: https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/eisenhower (read in a browser 2026-11-06): 'Eisenhower State Park provides 163 utility campsites: 126 with water/electric, 25 with water/electric/sewer hookups and five shower houses. Non-utility sites are available for primitive camping in Five-Star, Sailboat Beach, and Omaha Swim Beach. Fifteen Equestrian Campsites with electric/water and individual corrals are available in the upper loop of Westpoint Campground.'; 'Campers may stay at any one of the campgrounds for up to 14 consecutive days. Free WiFi is available at the park office/parking lot.'; 'Visit Ike's General Store located at Doud Campground to pay your campground fees'; 'Laundry facilities are available at the Doud shower building'; 'Contact Park Office (785) 528-4102'.

https://www.campitks.gov/camping/eisenhower-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519126, read 2026-11-06: 'Our State Park is OPEN year round! ALL utilities and the shower building in WestPoint Campground are open for winter campers. Electric and Water still available in BlackJack Campground. Electric Only in Abilene, Churchill and Doud Campgrounds ... The East Dump Station is also available.'; 'A reservation is not necessary unless you prefer a specific site and it's one that can be reserved. Reservations for stays between October and March can only be made by contacting the Park Office 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday to Friday 785-528-4102.'; 2027 holiday 3-night minimums; 14-consecutive-night rule per campground.

campitks.gov campsiteDetails.page for all 208 Eisenhower listings, read 2026-11-06: Abilene 10 (W/E 30 A), Black Jack 25 (W/E 50 A), Churchill 37 (W/E 50 A, 'Within 1/8 Mile'), Doud 53 (25 full hookup 50 A + 28 W/E 30 A, 27 pull-throughs), WestPoint 39 (12 full hookup 50 A + 27 W/E, incl. the equestrian upper loop 144-150/186-193) - 164 utility sites, 37 with sewer; listed vehicle lengths 30-119 ft; Five Star 30 primitive; 'River/Lake View: Y' on every site.

Esri World Imagery with the per-site coordinates (38.5155,-95.7450 at 520 m), 2026-11-06: Churchill's peninsula sites (e.g. 040-050) and Black Jack's south row sit ~20-50 m from the shore across open grass; WestPoint's lower loop ~40-80 m above the west cove; Doud inland on the ridge ~150-250 m from water. Stored pin 38.5176,-95.7489 is in WestPoint's upper (equestrian) loop.

values.note: Every utility site has water and electric: 37 full hookups (Doud 25, WestPoint 12), most others 50 A; Abilene and part of Doud and WestPoint are 30 A. In winter only WestPoint keeps all utilities; Black Jack keeps water and electric, the rest electric only.

values.note: 164 utility sites in five campgrounds - Doud (53), WestPoint (39, including 15 equestrian sites with corrals in the upper loop), Churchill (37), Black Jack (25) and Abilene (10); 33 pull-throughs. Primitive camping in Five Star (30 sites), Sailboat Beach and Omaha Swim Beach.

values.note: Reservable sites book online on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov) for April-September; stays October-March are reserved only by calling the park office (785-528-4102, weekdays 8-4). note: KDWP park on the north shore of Melvern Lake, in tallgrass prairie and woods: five utility campgrounds (WestPoint has 15 equestrian sites with corrals for the 20-mile Crooked Knee Horse Trail), primitive areas, cabins and yurts, swim beach, boat ramps and dock, disc golf, archery trail, Ike's General Store at Doud. Free WiFi at the park office. --Claude
summary: Confirmed showers, camp store, reservable, lakefront kept. Added full hookups to 50 A (37 sewer sites), 164 utility sites to 119 ft with pull-throughs, laundry, dump, flush toilets, 14-night rule, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum, Oct-Mar reservations by phone, open year round with winter utilities. Fees left as recorded (AWH 2026-10-15). Pin move suggested.
